item.title: Reflection on Unit 2
item.description:
Understanding the Nature of information problems through digital images.

In Unit 2, The Nature of Information Problem, I understood how images can be treated as data and analyzed computationally. Before this unit, I usually thought of images simply as pictures. But through classes and lab activities I realized that images are actually made up of pixels, and each pixels has a numerical intensity value. Working with grayscale images helped me understand this idea clearly as grayscale images do not contain colors but only different level of brightness. We did edge detection, extracting horizontal edges, blurring the images and rotating the images by different degrees. This unit changed the way I think of images. Instead of only seeing them visually, I started to see them as structured information that can be analyzed and tranformed using computational techniques.I learned Optimisation,Modelling, abstarction and bridges of Konigsberg, Modeling an elevator. In labs and classes we solved many problems related to optimization and Solved problems related to logustucs network optimization, Knapsack problems by doing these all i improved myself in information field . This unit helped me better understand how information problems can be approached using data analysis methods.

item.title: My First Post
item.description:
Learning About Information Concepts and Data Analysis.

In the 1st unit What is Information , i learned several new concepts and tools which helped me understand how information is structured and analyzed. I learned The DIKW Model, which explains the relationship between Data,Information , Knowledge and Wisdom. I understood how raw data can be processedd and interpreted to produce meaningful insights. Also we discussed the limitations of this model in class which made me realize that the information from data to knowledge is not always simple or linear. I learned Markdown which is very helpful skill that helps me to structure documents easily and made writing and organizing content clearer. In lab work as a group we worked on wiki practice and wrote wiki on 4th chapter of the Information: A History, a Theory, A flood by James Gleick the lesson taught me the ideas of Charles Babbage and Ada Lovelacetransformed calculation from human labor into programmable mechanical process, laying the foumdation for modern computing and information procrssing. I also understood how to analyze data like I analzed the Bangalore census education data using google sheeta. And created visual charts so that viwers can easily understand the data by just seeing. Overall I learned how to see how theoritical concepts about information can be connected with practical tools for analyzing and communicating data.
